item.title: "remains of the original recovery team"
item.content:encoded: Even though I have seen things of this sort here before, the off-hand way in which the document makes a transition from "ordinary" materials to this has firmly lifted it from "not bad" to "upvote-worthy" for me. My brain somehow failed to realise that if 862 converts everything into rats, it does convert EVERYTHING.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I like it, but I have 3 nits.

-There should be a smooth hemispherical crater marking the spot. Due to the ground inside the sphere of effect being converted.

-The portions split off should be cubed, not squared. Because they are making 3D rats, not flat rats.

-What happens to "leftovers" or objects smaller than the 25cm threshold? Due they turn into smaller rats, or partial rats, or just sit inert until enough material is in the field and then clump together into a hybrid material rat?

Instances of SCP-862-1 composed of air are regularly created, but are destroyed near-instantly, as they collapse when exposed to the slightest pressure.

Why would the foundation bother containing the instances of 862-1? It would be much more secure to simply destroy each resulting instance rather than let them run rampant in the hanger. It doesn't make much sense.

Other than that, I like it. Upvoted.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The affected portion will be dormant for a much shorter length of time before animating and assuming the behaviour of said rat.

This is wonderfully horrible. Not only victim's body slowly falling apart and turning into rats, but some parts of it will wiggle and try to bite victim while still attached to his body and retaining general form of organs and appendages. Poor, poor recovery team.

Upvote from me. "body-horror" in the tags would be nice.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
SCP-862 is an area spanning five meters located in the city of █████, ██████. This area possesses a sphere of influence that affects all materials. Upon arriving in SCP-862, materials will begin to split into portions of twenty five (25) centimeters.

Five square meters or five cubic meters (i.e. is it a sphere or a cylinder, or just a circle)? Also, 25 cubic centimeters or 25 square centimeters or what?

Also, you'd think the oxygen rats would be destroyed just like the air rats. Also, "fire" isn't a material, it's a chemical reaction.
